body:
Hey! I've also been looking at this issue and opened PR #122420 as another potential approach.
I found that when loading a scene from an empty tab the editor actually loads the state/selection the scene had previously, but that state gets overwritten by the empty scene's state when switching because they use the same tab.
My approach prevents that overwrite so that the previously saved state is restored. However, if there was nothing selected last time the scene was opened, my PR leaves it unselected. I tested your PR and saw that yours selects the root node when there is nothing selected. I really like that behavior! I have been thinking that, maybe, both approaches could work pretty well together: Restoring the selections when they exist, and selecting the root node when opening a scene that had no prior selection.
